fusions.name: Wayside Puff
fusions.desc: Flicks a spore at a target up to 5 tiles away that deals 5 damage, rising to 1.4 times that at full reach. Its damage rises 10% for every 100 paces you run since you last used it (max 50%).

fusions.name: Forced March
fusions.desc: Rushes up to 6 tiles to the target and deals 14 damage, leaving it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds and [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Steady Pace
fusions.desc: Increases your health recovery by 50% for 20 seconds.

fusions.name: Seeded Road
fusions.desc: Every few paces you travel, a spore bolt leaps to the nearest enemy within 4 tiles for 5 damage and leaves it [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds. Once every 6 seconds.
